questions.stem: A straight line drawn from the centre of a circle to a point on the circumference is called:
questions.explanation: A radius is a line segment from the centre of a circle to any point on its circumference. A diameter passes through the centre and connects two points on the circumference.

options.text: Is a straight line connecting two points on the circumference
Is always longer than the diameter
Is the same as an arc

questions.explanation: A chord is a straight line segment joining two points on the circumference. The diameter is a special chord that passes through the centre and is the longest possible chord.

questions.stem: The region between a chord and the arc it cuts off is called:
questions.explanation: A segment is the region between a chord and the arc. A sector is the region between two radii and an arc (like a pizza slice).
